mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 6 months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during a 6-month period when FEDFUNDS remains above 0.05, or FEDFUNDS does not decline by at least 0.5 percentage points from its previous value.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers a tightening cycle, raising discount rates on equities and driving negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the month following FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.0%, or the rate does not remain elevated for 30 days post-trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, boosting equity valuations and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST show rising trends, or their correlation falls below 0.8 over the 20-day period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained growth in the INDPRO supply index above its 104.1152 level (as of t-2mo) reduces inflationary pressures and supports equity valuations, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when INDPRO exceeds 104.1152 in late-cycle expansion, or supply growth decelerates below 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 6.0% percent over the next month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth prospects and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the month following UNRATE crossing above 6.0%, or UNRATE remains below 6.0 for the subsequent 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged rise in both the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL inflation index over 6 months signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity discount rates and generating negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL show sustained upward trends, or their correlation falls below 0.7 over the 6-month period.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession regime, sustained UNRATE above 7.0% over 6 months amplifies downward pressure on equity valuations, driving negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0 in a recession regime, or the recession regime ends prematurely.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in the federal funds rate above 0.10% in a single month triggers immediate negative 5-day forward returns as investors anticipate tighter policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.10%, or the FEDFUNDS spike is not sustained beyond the 5-day window.
